The newborn pups, born hairless and with closed eyes, require continuous thermoregulatory support from the mother during their first days ex utero.

By the time of weaning, the young have developed sufficient motor skills and digestive capabilities to begin foraging independently for seeds and vegetation.

Female Asia Minor ground squirrels attain an ultimate adult wet body mass of 328.8 grams [Wwi = 328.8 grams], a value that represents the asymptotic mass reached after the completion of skeletal growth and seasonal fattening cycles.
